# JackedIN

> The terminal, evolved. An SSH, Telnet and serial terminal with a desktop window, a full command line and a local automation API, for Windows and Linux.

JackedIN is a desktop terminal application. Run it with no arguments for the graphical window. Run it with a command and it stays in the terminal, prints a result, and exits, ready for scripts and pipes.

Official website: https://getjackedin.com/
The current product page is served at https://getpathprobe.com/jackedin/ (getjackedin.com redirects there).
Support: service@getpathprobe.com

## Features

- SSH, Telnet and serial consoles in one desktop window
- Full command-line interface (`jackedin ...`) for the same features
- Local automation API (off by default, 127.0.0.1 only, Bearer token)
- Serial consoles: DB9 RS-232 and RJ45-to-DB9 console cables; defaults to 9600 8N1; prefers common USB-serial adapters (FTDI, Prolific, CH340, CP210x)
- SSH: passwords, one-time codes, OpenSSH and PuTTY keys, ssh-agent and ~/.ssh/config; host-key checks that always warn on a changed key
- Source interface: pick the NIC or source IP for each outgoing connection
- Clean, readable text logs (including from Junos-style CR CR LF consoles); raw mode when you need control codes
- Tabs, split panes, a saved-session tree with search, recents, and reconnect after a dropped session
- Network tools: port scan, session-limit test, other-sessions indicator after SSH login, ping and traceroute
- Optional Wireshark/dumpcap capture on connect, including loopback filtered to the session port

SFTP file transfer is not in the current release. Only scan or connect to devices you own or are allowed to test.

## Platforms

- Windows 10 and 11 x64: installer or portable zip
- Ubuntu and Debian x86_64: .deb package
- Linux x86_64: portable zip
- macOS: coming soon

Every release includes SHA-256 checksums (SHA256SUMS) and a user's guide.

## Pricing

- Free 3-day trial: every feature unlocked, no card and no sign-up required
- License: $19 USD, one-time purchase. Includes 1 year of updates. Any version released in that year keeps working afterward.

Checkout is handled by Paddle, the merchant of record. All sales are final, except where required by law.

## Licensing

One license equals one computer and one user, and is non-transferable (Windows or Linux). After purchase, a license key is emailed; paste it into the app or run `jackedin license activate`. The trial becomes a licensed copy with no reinstall.
